source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第九课《古诗二首》
file_note: The workbook's exercises for 第九课, typed from 练习册A pp. 55–67 (PDF index = printed + 4; the lesson opens on p. 55 with the heading 古诗二首, and p. 68 is already 第十一课). Same shapes as L03–L05. The workbook prints no answers; every key here follows from the page, from the two poems on textbook pp. 92–93, or from the stroke data. The choose-A-or-B(-or-C) questions that L03–L05 left out are `pick` exercises here (星期三 练习1, 星期四 练习1, 星期五 练习1 and 练习3), with the book's own options in the book's order. Still out: 星期五 练习3 item (4), whose key the page does not settle (see that exercise's scope_note). 星期五 练习2 (pp. 65–66, 读一读《四季风》, a twelve-line nursery rhyme of the workbook's own) is left out as L03 left out 《故宫》: a passage stays in the book, by the owner's decision of 2 October (docs/chinese.md § 8); she reads it from the workbook. Two book exercises are split, as L04 split its 描一描写一写: 星期一 练习1 into a write and a sort, and 星期一/星期二 练习4 into a match and the writing of what was matched; 星期三 练习2, three 选词填空 groups with their own two or three characters, is three match exercises, as L03 did its 完、玩、晚. There is no 父母读给孩子听 or retell in this lesson's workbook, so no speak exercise.

exercises.title: 填写正确答案
exercises.title_en: Fill in the correct answers

note.zh: 先写部首，再写笔画数或者那一笔的名字（比如：横、竖、撇、点、横折）。
note.en: Write the radical first, then the number of strokes or the name of that stroke (such as 横, 竖, 撇, 点, 横折).

exercises.key_note: Keys, settled by the radicals the textbook prints and by the stroke data in content/chinese/strokes (hanzi-writer medians checked stroke by stroke): (1) 闻 — radical 门, 9 strokes (门 3 + 耳 6). (2) 皆 — radical 白; the textbook p. 94 prints 白、比——皆, so 比 is right as well; the fourth stroke is 竖弯钩, the last stroke of 比 on top (横, 竖提, 撇, 竖弯钩, then 白). (3) 辛 — radical 辛, it is its own radical; 7 strokes. (4) 苦 — radical 艹; the seventh stroke is 横折 (艹 横 竖 竖, then 古 横 竖, 口 竖 横折 横 — eight in all). A free item, not a four-choice one, because the book gives no choices to choose from.

items.prompt_en: (1) The radical of 闻 is ＿＿, and it has ＿＿ strokes.
(2) The radical of 皆 is ＿＿, and its fourth stroke is ＿＿.
(3) The radical of 辛 is ＿＿, and it has ＿＿ strokes.
(4) The radical of 苦 is ＿＿, and its seventh stroke is ＿＿.

exercises.title: 选出带有下列偏旁部首的字
exercises.title_en: Select the characters with the following radicals

note.zh: 课本的例子：纟——抗、红、块，勾的是"红"。每行三个字，带有这个偏旁部首的就勾上。这里每个字判断一次：带有，选"对"；不带，选"错"。
note.en: The book's example: 纟 — 抗, 红, 块, and 红 is ticked. Each row has three characters; tick the ones that have the radical. Here each character is one true-or-false: true if it has it, false if not.

exercises.shape_note: A row of three checkboxes per radical, and the instruction is to tick the characters that carry it — a tick per box, not one answer per row, so each box is one tf item. The text is authored as a statement about the box; the characters and radicals are the book's. In the book each row has exactly one: 眠, 闻, 铁, 盘.

explanation.zh: 晓的左边是日字旁，不是目：日＋尧。
explanation.en: 晓 has 日, the sun, on the left — not 目, the eye: 日 + 尧.

explanation.zh: 皆是比在上、白在下，里面没有目。
explanation.en: 皆 is 比 over 白; there is no 目 in it.

explanation.zh: 眠的左边是目字旁：睡觉要闭上眼睛。
explanation.en: 眠 has 目 on the left: you close your eyes to sleep.

explanation.zh: 闻是门字框，里面是耳：门＋耳。
explanation.en: 闻 is 耳 inside 门, so it has 门.

explanation.zh: 国的外面是四面围起来的囗，不是门。
explanation.en: 国 is closed in on all four sides by 囗, not by 门.

explanation.zh: 凶的外面是凵，从下面包着，不是门。
explanation.en: 凶 is held from below by 凵, not by 门.

explanation.zh: 滴的左边是三点水（氵）：水滴是水，不是金属。
explanation.en: 滴 has 氵, the water radical — a drop is water — not 钅.

explanation.zh: 铁的左边是金字旁（钅）：铁是一种金属。
explanation.en: 铁 has 钅, the metal radical: iron is a metal.

explanation.zh: 饭的左边是食字旁（饣），不是钅：饭是吃的。两个偏旁长得像，看清楚下面。
explanation.en: 饭 has 饣, the food radical, not 钅: rice is food. The two look alike, so look at the bottom of the radical.

explanation.zh: 盘的下面是皿：盘子是装东西的器皿。
explanation.en: 盘 has 皿 at the bottom: a plate is a dish for holding things.

explanation.zh: 李是木在上、子在下，没有皿。
explanation.en: 李 is 木 over 子; there is no 皿.

explanation.zh: 杏是木在上、口在下，没有皿。
explanation.en: 杏 is 木 over 口; there is no 皿.

exercises.title: 选出下列句中画线字的正确解释
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct interpretations of the underlined words

note.zh: 每句诗里画线的字写在句子后面。选出它在诗里的意思。
note.en: The underlined character of each line is named after the line. Choose what it means in the poem.

items.text: （1）锄禾日当午　画线的字："日"

explanation.zh: 锄禾日当午：太阳正在头顶上，正是中午。这里的"日"是太阳。
explanation.en: 锄禾日当午: the sun is right overhead, so it is noon. Here 日 is the sun.

items.text: （2）春眠不觉晓　画线的字："晓"

explanation.zh: 春眠不觉晓：春天睡得香，不知道天已经亮了。"晓"是天亮，《春晓》写的就是春天的早上。
explanation.en: 春眠不觉晓: sleeping soundly in spring, not noticing it is already light. 晓 is daybreak, and 春晓 is a spring morning.

items.text: （3）处处闻啼鸟　画线的字："闻"

explanation.zh: 处处闻啼鸟：到处都听见鸟叫。鸟叫是用耳朵听的——"闻"里面就有一个"耳"。今天常说用鼻子闻，可在这句古诗里，"闻"是听见。
explanation.en: 处处闻啼鸟: birdsong is heard everywhere. You hear birds with your ears, and there is an 耳 inside 闻. Today 闻 usually means to smell, but in this old poem it means to hear.

items.text: （4）粒粒皆辛苦　画线的字："皆"

explanation.zh: 粒粒皆辛苦：每一粒都是辛苦换来的。"皆"就是"都"。
explanation.en: 粒粒皆辛苦: every single grain came from hard work. 皆 means all, 都.

exercises.title: 给下面的诗句排序
exercises.title_en: Put the following lines in the correct order

note.zh: 《春晓》的四句被打乱了，按诗里的顺序排好。
note.en: The four lines of 春晓 are out of order; put them back in the poem's order.

explanation.zh: 《春晓》的顺序：春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。夜来风雨声，花落知多少。先是早上醒来，再听到鸟叫，然后想起夜里的风雨，最后想到落了多少花。
explanation.en: The order of 春晓: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。夜来风雨声，花落知多少。 — waking late on a spring morning, then the birds everywhere, then remembering the wind and rain of the night, and last wondering how many flowers fell.

explanation.zh: 课本第92页：《春晓》（唐）孟浩然。李绅写的是《悯农》。
explanation.en: Textbook p. 92: 春晓, by （唐）孟浩然. 李绅 wrote 悯农.

items.text: （2）《春晓》中哪一句是写“人们到处都能听见小鸟的啼叫声”？

explanation.zh: 处处是到处，闻是听见，啼鸟是叫着的小鸟：处处闻啼鸟。
explanation.en: 处处 is everywhere, 闻 is hear, and 啼鸟 are birds singing: 处处闻啼鸟.

items.text: （3）写《悯农》的诗人李绅是哪个朝代的？

explanation.zh: 课本第93页：《悯农》（唐）李绅——李绅是唐代诗人。
explanation.en: Textbook p. 93: 悯农, by （唐）李绅 — 李绅 was a poet of the Tang dynasty.

items.text: （4）《悯农》中描写“农民的汗水都滴在了土地上”的是哪一句？

explanation.zh: 汗滴禾下土：汗水滴到禾苗下面的土里。
explanation.en: 汗滴禾下土: sweat drips into the soil beneath the crops.

exercises.title: 读课文，填一填
exercises.title_en: Read the text and fill

note.zh: 《悯农》缺了一些字，把缺的字写进格子里。
note.en: Some characters of 悯农 are missing; write them into the cells.

exercises.key_note: Keys, from 《悯农》 on textbook p. 93: (1) 锄、当 (2) 汗滴 (3) 盘、餐 (4) 粒粒皆辛苦. Free rather than write because the workbook gives no pinyin and a write item shows one, which would turn recall into 看拼音写汉字.

exercises.title: 读课文，判断正误
exercises.title_en: Read the text and decide whether the statements are true or false

items.text: 《春晓》和《悯农》这两首诗都是唐代诗人写的。

explanation.zh: 课本上两首诗都标着（唐）：孟浩然和李绅都是唐代诗人。
explanation.en: Both poems are marked （唐） in the book: 孟浩然 and 李绅 were both Tang-dynasty poets.

items.text: “春眠不觉晓”这句的意思是：春天的时候睡觉，天亮了还不知道。

explanation.zh: 春眠是春天睡觉，不觉晓是不知道天已经亮了。
explanation.en: 春眠 is sleeping in spring, and 不觉晓 is not noticing that it is already light.

items.text: “谁知盘中餐”这句的意思是：谁都不知道盘子去哪儿了。

explanation.zh: "盘中餐"是盘子里的饭菜，下一句接着说"粒粒皆辛苦"——每一粒都来得很辛苦。诗里没有说盘子去哪儿了。
explanation.en: 盘中餐 is the food on the plate, and the next line goes on: 粒粒皆辛苦, every grain of it came from hard work. Nothing in the poem is about where a plate went.

items.text: 《悯农》这首诗是让我们知道农民伯伯种地辛苦，要好好珍惜粮食。

explanation.zh: 前两句写农民中午还在锄地，汗滴到土里；后两句说每一粒粮食都来得辛苦，所以要珍惜。
explanation.en: The first two lines show the farmer hoeing at noon with his sweat dripping into the soil; the last two say every grain was hard to grow, so we should not waste food.

exercises.title: 选择相应的语句补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct expressions to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 朵朵考方方三个问题，方方的三句回答缺了，从三句里选。对话最后朵朵说：哈哈，你都答对了。真棒！
note.en: Duoduo asks Fangfang three questions and Fangfang's three answers are missing; choose each from the three lines. At the end Duoduo says: 哈哈，你都答对了。真棒！

options: 意思是“谁知道我们盘中的粮食，它们每一粒都是农民的辛苦换来的”
农民伯伯劳作不容易，我们要珍惜粮食
锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土

items.before: 朵朵：方方，我来考考你，你知道《悯农》这首诗里哪一句是写农民伯伯中午还在劳作，汗水都滴落在田里的吗？　方方：我知道，是“______”。

explanation.zh: 写农民中午还在劳作、汗水滴在田里的，是前两句：锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土。
explanation.en: The farmer still working at noon with his sweat dripping on the field is the first two lines: 锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土.

items.before: 朵朵：那你知道“谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦”是什么意思吗？　方方：______。

explanation.zh: 问的是这两句的意思，回答就从"意思是"说起：谁知道我们盘中的粮食，每一粒都是农民的辛苦换来的。
explanation.en: She asks what the two lines mean, so the answer starts 意思是: who knows that every grain on our plate was earned by the farmers' hard work.

items.before: 朵朵：你知道这首诗想要告诉我们什么吗？　方方：这首诗想要告诉我们______。

explanation.zh: 这首诗想告诉我们的道理：农民伯伯劳作不容易，我们要珍惜粮食。
explanation.en: What the poem wants to tell us: the farmers' work is hard, so we should treasure our food.

exercises.title: 听句子选择正确的图片
exercises.title_en: Listen to the sentences and choose the correct pictures

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第83页附录里第9课的听力文本（或放录音），每听一句，选一张图。图在练习册第64–65页，每题两张，标着A和B。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 9 listening script in the appendix on workbook p. 83 (or play the recording); choose a picture after each sentence. The pictures are on workbook pp. 64–65, two for each, lettered A and B.

exercises.script_note: The script (附录 p. 83, 第9课) is not typed here, by the pick rules; the explanations quote each sentence, as L03's listening tf did, because they are shown only after she has chosen.

explanation.zh: 听到的是"我们都是小学生"：图A是两个背书包、拿着书的小学生；图B里有一个大人。
explanation.en: The sentence is 我们都是小学生, we are all primary-school pupils: picture A shows two schoolboys; picture B has a grown man in it.

explanation.zh: 听到的是"小鸟在树上啼叫"：图B是树枝上的小鸟；图A是一只猴子。
explanation.en: The sentence is 小鸟在树上啼叫, a bird singing in a tree: picture B is the bird on a branch; picture A is a monkey.

explanation.zh: 听到的是"米饭是一粒一粒的"：图B是一碗米饭；图A是一碗面条。
explanation.en: The sentence is 米饭是一粒一粒的, rice comes grain by grain: picture B is a bowl of rice; picture A is a bowl of noodles.

explanation.zh: 听到的是"农民伯伯种田很辛苦"：图A是在田里种苗的农民；图B是坐在小凳子上吃东西的孩子。
explanation.en: The sentence is 农民伯伯种田很辛苦, farming is hard work: picture A is a farmer planting seedlings in a field; picture B is a boy eating on a stool.

exercises.title: 根据上面的儿歌选一选，并涂上你喜欢的颜色
exercises.title_en: Choose according to the nursery rhyme above and color with your favorite color

note.zh: 先读练习册第65–66页的儿歌《四季风》，再根据儿歌选。涂颜色在练习册上做。
note.en: First read the nursery rhyme 四季风 on workbook pp. 65–66, then choose by it. The coloring is done in the workbook.

exercises.scope_note: Item (4) 这首儿歌都写了些什么？ (A 写了一年四季的风。 / B 写了四季的颜色。) is left out: A is the likelier reading, from the title 四季风, but every verse also gives the wind a color, so B is defensible and the page does not settle it beyond doubt. The crown coloring is not a choice and stays on paper. The rhyme itself is not typed: a passage of the workbook's own stays in the book.

explanation.zh: 儿歌第一段说春天的风是绿的，小草一看到它就绿了。黄色的是秋天的风。
explanation.en: The first verse says the spring wind is green, and the grass turns green when it sees it. Yellow is the autumn wind.

options: 因为天上的云是黑色的。

explanation.zh: 儿歌说夏天的风带来了黑云，所以是黑的。落下来的是小雨珠，雨不是黑的。
explanation.en: The rhyme says the summer wind brings black clouds, which is why it is black. What falls is little raindrops, and rain is not black.

explanation.zh: 儿歌说冬天下雪，到处都变白了。冷不是一种颜色。
explanation.en: The rhyme says that in winter it snows and everything turns white. Cold is not a color.

exercises.title: 读拼音，写出相应的汉字
exercises.title_en: Read Pinyin and write characters

note.zh: 看拼音和句子，把字写出来。
note.en: From the pinyin and the sentence, write the character.

items.context: 到处都能听到鸟儿的＿叫声。

explanation.zh: 啼叫：tí，鸟叫——处处闻啼鸟。
explanation.en: 啼叫 — tí, a bird's call, as in 处处闻啼鸟.

items.context: 我的汉语水平有很大的＿高。

explanation.zh: 提高：tí，提手旁（扌）。和"啼"同音，可这是提高的"提"。
explanation.en: 提高 — tí, to raise. Same sound as 啼, but this is 提, with 扌, the hand radical.

items.context: 天气太热了，＿水不停地往下掉。

explanation.zh: 汗水：hàn——汗滴禾下土。
explanation.en: 汗水 — hàn, sweat, as in 汗滴禾下土.

explanation.zh: 早餐：cān——谁知盘中餐。
explanation.en: 早餐 — cān, breakfast; 餐 as in 谁知盘中餐.

items.context: 爸爸妈妈平时工作都很辛＿。

explanation.zh: 辛苦：kǔ——粒粒皆辛苦。
explanation.en: 辛苦 — kǔ, hard work, as in 粒粒皆辛苦.

exercises.title: 春天、夏天、秋天和冬天，你最喜欢哪个季节？为什么？请你写一写
exercises.title_en: Spring, summer, autumn and winter, which season do you like best and why? Please write

note.zh: 提示：（1）现在是什么季节？风景怎么样？有什么是你喜欢的？（2）你在这个季节可以做什么？（3）你的心情怎么样？（用中文表达，50字以上）
note.en: Prompts: (1) What season is it now? What does it look like? What do you like about it? (2) What can you do in this season? (3) How do you feel? (Write in Chinese, more than 50 characters.)
